verses.1: Oh, those who write and create words! They work hard in their writing.
verses.2: To oppress the poor and to violate the laws of my people, so that they become weak and helpless. Their days will be filled with suffering.
verses.3: And what will they do on the day of judgment? They will be separated from each other. Who will they turn to for help? And they will leave, with their pride intact.
verses.4: In all this, he did not fall under the power of the prisoners and those who were bound. His head remained raised, and his hands were still extended.
verses.5: Oh Ashur, you are a tyrant who holds power in his hands. My anger is upon him.
verses.6: In the land of Hana’af, I will send them there. And to the people of Ebrathi, I command them to plunder and destroy everything in their path. Their faces shall be covered with ashes, just like those of those who are destroyed by fire.
verses.7: And he certainly did not do so. His heart also did not think that it was right to destroy nations with his actions.
verses.8: For it is said, “The kings shall reign together.”
verses.9: It’s not like we can do anything about it, unless we act with determination or resolve.
verses.10: When my hands were able to find the kings of the idols, and their followers in Jerusalem and Samaria.
verses.11: Now, just as I have done with Shomron and its idols, so too will I do with Jerusalem and its idols.
verses.12: And it shall be that, as Adonai carried out all his plans in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, so too it will affect the prosperity of the king of Assyria, and the splendor of his eyes.
verses.13: For by the power of my hands I have done this; and by my wisdom I have planned it all. I have broken free from the bonds of nations, and I have set them aside as prisoners. They are like soldiers who sit in their positions.
verses.14: And I found a nest of chicks belonging to the people’s army. All over the land, they were gathering up eggs. I gathered them together, but none of them had wings or beaks. They were completely helpless.
verses.15: The acacia tree will flourish on its soil. If its branches grow taller, then it will become like a ruler who rules over others. Its branches will rise high up, like mountains without any trees in sight.
verses.16: Therefore, the Lord God will send His armies before Him. Under His command, they will act as if they were flames.
verses.17: And it shall be that the light of Israel shall be like fire, and its holiness shall be like flame. It shall also destroy and consume everything in one day.
verses.18: And its forests and vineyards would be destroyed from top to bottom. It would become like a desolate wasteland.
verses.19: And the rest of the trees in the forest will be counted, and a boy will write down their names.
verses.20: And on that day, no one from Israel would continue to live there anymore. The descendants of Jacob would be freed from their suffering, and they would be saved by the Holy God of Israel, in truth.
verses.21: The rest of Jacob will return to El-Gibor.
verses.22: For if your people, Israel, become like the sea that is in turmoil; then all its waters will return to their original state, and justice will be restored.
verses.23: For all things are under the control of Jehovah’s army, who act throughout the entire earth.
verses.24: Therefore, as Adonai YHWH says, do not be afraid of my people who dwell in Zion from Ashur. They will be defeated and their power will be taken away from them. They will be brought down upon you along the way to Egypt.
verses.25: For there is still much anger and all kinds of wrath upon them.
verses.26: And Jehovah will bring upon him his armies, like a swarm of bees. They will carry him across the sea, and they will carry him along the path to Egypt.
verses.27: And on that day, his penis will be removed from above your vagina, and it will also be removed from above your chest. It will be pulled away from in front of your genitals.
verses.28: He came upon the valley, and he assigned everything to its proper place.
verses.29: They crossed over the boundary of Malon to us. It was a false fear and deception. The land of Shaul was tried by them.
verses.30: My voice cries out to you, daughter of Galiim. Listen to Yishah’s humble requests.
verses.31: The inhabitants of the high places were scattered far away.
verses.32: Today, as I stand here, I feel the wind blowing across Mount Zion’s foothills, the hills of Jerusalem.
verses.33: Look! The army of Jehovah’s angels is moving forward through the valleys and high mountains. They will be defeated.
verses.34: And the branches of the tree will be caught in the net, and the leaves will be torn away by the strong wind.
